plugins.description: A reader-first writing system: structure, draft, diagnose, revise, and review documents across argument architecture and sentence-level prose, with fidelity-preserving revision and independent review. Routes by writing goal (plan, draft, diagnose, restructure, revise, adapt, compare, review, finalize, teach).
